title: Full Moon in Sagittarius
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Sagittarius / Gemini axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates truth, faith, travel, teaching, perspective, and the message that grows from lived experience through the Sagittarius side of the axis, while the Sun in Gemini asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: philosophy without embodiment, certainty that stops listening, or escape dressed as freedom
integration: living the wisdom you claim to believe

twoWeekArc.teaching: A small message now can reveal a bigger truth when the opposite-sign Full Moon arrives.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Sagittarius / Gemini balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Jupiter kamea, yellow or white candle, citrine, turquoise or green jasper, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Sagittarius can be embodied without rejecting Gemini.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Sagittarius, and what balance with Gemini is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Sagittarius Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
